response.text: Several findings so far. Let me check the closed-period postings (all periods appear closed, so I need to confirm which journals are in closed periods versus the posting date), the account 5900 usage, and the invoice-to-journal amount tie-out.

arguments.sql: SELECT DISTINCT j."JRNL_NO", j."ACCT_CD", j."DR_AMT", j."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNL" j WHERE TRIM(j."ACCT_CD")='5900' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", COALESCE(SUM(j."DR_AMT"),0) AS dr, COALESCE(SUM(j."CR_AMT"),0) AS cr FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(j."DR_AMT"),0)-i."INV_AMT")>0.005 AND ABS(COALESCE(SUM(j."CR_AMT"),0)-i."INV_AMT")>0.005 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100

SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", p."PAY_AMT" FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID" NOT IN (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APINVH") OR p."PAY_DT" NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT 1 FROM "APINVH" WHERE 1=0) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
